description: Machine learning model predicting customers who are likely to leave OrbitTel based on usage and subscription patterns
data_inputs: Customer usage data; subscription history; service plan data; interaction history
outputs: Churn probability score; customer risk segment; retention prioritisation list
notes: Used to support customer retention activities. Current documented purpose does not include automated service termination, eligibility decisions, or other significant automated decisions. Governance review should be repeated if the system's decision role changes.

description: Generative AI assistant providing response suggestions and information retrieval support to customer service agents
data_inputs: Customer interaction history; service information; product documentation; approved knowledge articles
outputs: AI-generated response suggestions; retrieved service information; recommended next response
notes: Human agents remain responsible for customer responses. Governance focus includes transparency where customers directly receive AI-generated content, hallucination controls, protection of customer information, logging, and human review.

description: Predictive model identifying network conditions that may indicate an increased probability of future fiber network faults
primary_purpose: Proactive network maintenance and fault prediction
data_inputs: Network performance metrics; equipment telemetry; historical fault records; maintenance records
outputs: Fault probability score; predicted fault alerts; affected network element list
notes: Used to support network maintenance decisions rather than directly making decisions about individuals. Operational reliability, false positives, false negatives, model performance, and human review require ongoing governance.

description: Machine learning system detecting unusual usage patterns that may indicate potential misuse or fraudulent activity
data_inputs: Usage records; transaction data; subscription information; behavioural patterns
outputs: Fraud risk score; anomaly alerts; investigation queue
geographic_scope: Egypt; OrbitTel consumer and enterprise services
notes: System identifies cases for investigation and does not by itself establish that fraud occurred. Human investigation is required before adverse customer action. Governance focus includes false positives, fairness, explainability, data protection, investigation evidence, and escalation.

description: Machine learning forecasting system predicting future network traffic and capacity requirements to support infrastructure planning
primary_purpose: Network capacity planning and investment support
data_inputs: Historical network traffic; capacity utilisation; subscriber growth; geographic demand patterns
outputs: Traffic forecasts; capacity projections; capacity risk alerts; planning scenarios
geographic_scope: Egypt; OrbitTel mobile and broadband networks
notes: Currently in pilot and supports planning decisions rather than decisions about individuals. Governance focus includes forecast accuracy, scenario reliability, data quality, business continuity, model monitoring, and human review of major planning decisions.
